The 6th Anniversary Balloon Hat is a SPECIAL Hatcessory that was given out during the 6th SkyBlock Anniversary.

Contents

  • 1 Obtaining
    • 1.1 Game Message
  • 2 Usage
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Trivia
  • 5 History
  • 6 Navigation

Obtaining

[edit | edit source]

The 6th Anniversary Balloon Hat was distributed by Simon during the 6th SkyBlock Anniversary in the Hub.

Game Message

[edit | edit source]
Condition Message
Collecting Balloon Hat
[NPC] Simon: It's time for celebration!
[NPC] Simon: SkyBlock is turning 6 years old today!
[NPC] Simon: We're happy to have had you along for the journey so far!
You claimed a [Expression] 6th Anniversary Balloon Hat!
Another player collects Balloon Hat
Simon gave a [Expression] 6th Anniversary Balloon Hat to <player>!
Attempting to claim another Balloon Hat
[NPC] Simon: I've already given you a Balloon Hat for this year! Happy Anniversary!

Usage

[edit | edit source]

The 6th Anniversary Balloon Hat grants +1  Magic Find. It additionally provides +1  Intelligence for each SkyBlock Year played when worn. The  Magic Find bonus can only be obtained once from Hatcessories.

When stored in the player's  Accessory Bag, the 6th Anniversary Balloon Hat will count for Accessory Power. All Hatcessories count for the same Accessory Power, meaning one of any kind will count for the same as all available ones combined.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • If player equips more than one Balloon Hat, only one of them will give stat bonus, resulting in only +1  Magic Find bonus.
  • Hatcessories are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary".
